name: Nirvana Gigas
body:
Nirvana gigas
CR 18

The great, statuary humanoid in the distance has brilliant–colored skin and hair which shift continuously in hue. Its eyes are strangely distant and glazed, and around its feet the very terrain seems to change.

XP 153,600
NG Gargantuan humanoid (extraplanar, giant, good)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., dreamsight, low-light vision; Perception +42

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 12, flat-footed 27 (+6 armor, +6 Dex, +15 natural, -4 size)
hp 294 (28d8+168)
Fort +22, Ref +15, Will +19
Defensive Abilities rock catching; DR 10/evil; Immune cold, sleep, effects that target only humanoids; Resist acid 10, electricity 10, fire 10, sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +31/+26/+21/+16 (1d8+14)
Ranged rock +23 (4d6+21)
Space 20 ft., Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks bewildering unarmed strike, neverending dream, rock throwing (180 ft.)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 18th, concentration +26)

At will—alter self, blend with surroundings (DC 19), blur
3/day—charm person (DC 19), golden guise, hallucinatory terrain (DC 22), mass invisibility (DC 25), psychic asylum, shadow evocation (DC 23), subjective reality, mass synesthesia (DC 25)
1/day—create armaments, dream voyage (DC 27), akashic form

Mesmerist Spells Known (CL 18th, concentration +26)

6th (4/day)—dream travel (DC 24), greater create mindscape (DC 24), overwhelming presence (DC 24), project image (DC 24)
5th (5/day)—cloak of dreams (DC 23), dream council (DC 23), dream scan (DC 23), waves of fatigue
4th (7/day)—create mindscape (DC 22), dream, mass daze (DC 22), mindwipe (DC 22), sleepwalk (DC 22)
3rd (7/day)—confusion (DC 21), deep slumber (DC 21), dream dalliance (DC 21), greater oneiric horror (DC 21), mindscape door (DC 21), out of sight (DC 21)
2nd (7/day)—absurdity (DC 20), calm emotions (DC 20), detect mindscape, dream shield, mantle of calm (DC 20), oneiric horror (DC 20)
1st (7/day)—anticipate peril (DC 19), burst of insight, heightened awareness, illusion of calm (DC 19), lesser confusion (DC 19), mental block (DC 19)
0th (At Will)—daze (DC 18), detect magic, ghost sound (DC 18), lullaby (DC 18), read magic, touch of fatigue (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 38, Dex 23, Con 22, Int 21, Wis 25, Cha 27
Base Atk +21; CMB +32 (34 with bull rush); CMD 48 (50 vs. bull rush)
Feats Alertness, Awesome Blow, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Iron Will, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Lucid Dreamer, One Eye Open, Power Attack, Tiring Critical, Traumatic Spell-Like Ability (shadow evocation), Will of Giants
Skills Climb +45, Diplomacy +36, Intimidate +39, Knowledge (planes) +33, Perception +42, Sense Motive +39, Spellcraft +33
Languages Celestial, Common, Giant
SQ planar empowerment

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dreamsight (Su)

With a brief glance, a Nirvana gigas can see a hazy image of the current dreams of sleeping creatures.

Neverending Dream (Su)

In its dozing state, a Nirvana gigas behaves as if under a permanent sleepwalk effect.

Everything within 10 miles of the gigas transforms into its dreamscape.

All creatures caught or entering into the gigas’ dreamscape are in their physical bodies. Those with less than 10 HD automatically believe it to be real; those with 10 HD or more can realize the situation with a successful Will save (DC 32). The save DC is Charisma–based.

The dreamscape has the alterable morphic, normal magic and erratic time traits. Once within, one can only get out by killing the gigas at its center (which is conscious and able to defend itself in its own dream), persuading the gigas to awake (Diplomacy or Intimidate, DC 32), or leading the dream to a conclusion that is satisfying for the gigas.

When the dreamscape dissolves, the gigas is fatigued; other creatures face no more consequences than if awakening from a normal dream. If the gigas was killed, though, any damage and deaths suffered while in the dreamscape remain in the real world too.

Planar Empowerment (Su)

While on the plane of Nirvana, a Nirvana gigas can cast each of the following as a spell-like ability once per day: holy aura (DC 31), holy word (DC 30), and whirlwind (DC 31). If the gigas ventures onto another plane, it can’t use these abilities (though its other spell-like abilities remain available). The save DCs for these spell-like abilities are Charisma-based and include a +5 racial bonus.

Spell Casting

A Nirvana gigas casts spells as a 18th-level mesmerist.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Nirvana)
Organization solitary
Treasure standard (+0 bewildering amulet of mighty fists, bracers of armor +6, other treasure)

A Nirvana gigas stands well over 50 feet tall and weighs 20 tons. Its hair comes in a spectrum of bright colors, from pink to green and orange, with blue skin splashed with yellow and orange.

These creatures lose themselves in epoch-long dreams, creating entire worlds in their minds where to find romance, entertainment, or the answer to philosophical questions. Whoever helps them to fulfill these needs and awake is granted their eternal gratitude and loyalty.
